choice.basis: The dashboard is a choropleth titled 'Incidence of Condition A in US States' where darker colors indicate higher values. California (CA) is shaded in the darkest red/maroon category (approaching the 'High' end of the 100 scale), visually indicating the highest incidence among the provided options. Tennessee (TN) is light yellow (low), and Delaware (DE) is not a priority candidate for the highest-incidence workflow.
choice.option_label: Open California (CA) incidence detail for priority follow-up
